from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyInvestingCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Extracted investing cash flow data for a single company to enable change comparison."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the filing belongs to")
    current_period_date: str | None = Field(description="End date of the current quarter being reported")
    current_flow_label: str | None = Field(description="Description of the cash flow line item for current period (e.g. 'net cash used in investing activities', 'net cash provided by investing activities')")
    current_amount: float | None = Field(description="Net cash flow amount for the current period")
    prior_period_date: str | None = Field(description="End date of the comparable prior period")
    prior_flow_label: str | None = Field(description="Description of the cash flow line item for prior period")
    prior_amount: float | None = Field(description="Net cash flow amount for the prior period")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    records: list[CompanyInvestingCashFlow]
